annotations.title: Remove a tool server from a Nod

description: Takes one server that needs no sign-in off the Nod; its tools stop reaching new sessions. A version online that grants its tools is no longer served until your owner puts it online again. Needs a confirmed owner. On only for accounts NodNod has opened it for; any other answers not_live.
